### Giving While You’re Living
Author: Chuck Swindoll
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/todays-insight-chuck-swindoll/todays-insight-september-19-2024.html
Passage: Genesis 25:5-6
Points:
- Abraham responsibly provided for all of his children, giving his sons financial resources before they departed to start families.
- Having learned from previously sending Hagar and Ishmael away with minimal provisions, he made intentional arrangements for his sons by Keturah.
- Distributing gifts while he was still living allowed him to witness his family being blessed and avoid future estate conflicts.
- He preserved the covenant inheritance by ensuring the primary estate and divine promises remained with Isaac.
- Practicing proactive generosity during his lifetime enabled Abraham to finish his life content, peaceful, and satisfied.
